description: This file defines data structures and a manager for handling static and dynamic variables within a debugging context, including a constructor for the VariablesManager class.

classes.name: VariablesManager
classes.description: Manages and provides access to Variables, initialized with static variables.

methods.name: NewVariablesManager
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new VariablesManager with specified static variables.

methods.name: GetVariables
methods.description: Returns a Variables instance containing the static variables managed by this manager.
